name: orbitwell-golden
description: Golden questions over the fictional Orbitwell Robotics corpus, covering single-source, identifier, multi-source, paraphrase and unanswerable cases for scoring retrieval, citations and answers.

corpus.title: OW-X7 Collaborative Robot Arm User Manual

items.question: How many days of paid vacation do I get per year once I've been with Orbitwell for more than four years?
items.referenceAnswer: From the first day of your fifth year of service you get 27 days of paid vacation per year (2.25 days accrued per month), up from 22 days in years 1 to 4.

items.question: How much unused vacation can I take with me into next year, and when do leftover 2026 days run out?
items.referenceAnswer: You can carry over at most 6 days of unused vacation, and days carried over from 2026 must be taken by 31 March 2027.

items.question: What do I get reimbursed per kilometre when I drive my own car on a business trip?
items.referenceAnswer: Private car use is reimbursed at €0.32 per km plus motorway tolls and parking, but it needs prior approval and is only allowed when it is cheaper than rail or a rental car.

items.question: Who has to approve an expense report that totals €3,000, and what amount range does that approver cover?
items.referenceAnswer: A €3,000 report needs your department director, who approves reports from €1,200.01 to €5,000; line managers approve up to €1,200 and reports above €5,000 go to the Head of Finance.

items.question: How long does my passphrase have to be, and is the rule different for admin accounts?
items.referenceAnswer: Standard accounts need a passphrase of at least 16 characters; privileged accounts such as domain, Fleet production or network administration need at least 24 characters.

items.question: How often does the security team send out fake phishing emails to test us?
items.referenceAnswer: The Information Security Office runs simulated phishing campaigns every six weeks, and results are reported per department, never per person.

items.question: What's the maximum payload of the OW-X7 arm and how far can it reach?
items.referenceAnswer: The OW-X7 carries a payload of up to 7 kg and has a reach of 917 mm.

items.question: The OW-X7 pendant is showing error E-319. What does it mean and how do I clear it?
items.referenceAnswer: E-319 is a safety configuration checksum mismatch: the active safety configuration does not match the checksum stored in the safety controller. Review the configuration under Settings → Safety and re-confirm it with the safety password; after restoring a backup, compare the checksum with the value recorded in your risk assessment.

items.question: When was OW-X7 firmware 3.4.0 released and what new features does it bring?
items.referenceAnswer: Firmware 3.4.0 was released on 22 June 2026. It adds conveyor tracking (up to two conveyors, requires an OW-CB2 revision C or later), path blending with a blend-radius parameter, Fleet remote diagnostics, and a pendant dark theme plus Slovak and Hungarian languages.

items.question: How fast will Orbitwell support first respond to a P3 ticket if we're on the Standard tier?
items.referenceAnswer: On the Standard tier, the first response to a P3 (Normal) ticket comes within 2 business days, counted within Standard support hours (Monday–Friday 08:00–17:00 CET).

items.question: What availability does Orbitwell promise for the Fleet dashboard each month, and what credit do we get if it drops under 95%?
items.referenceAnswer: Orbitwell commits to 99.9% monthly uptime for the Fleet dashboard and API; if monthly uptime falls below 95.0%, the service credit is 50% of that month's Fleet subscription fee, requested within 45 days.

items.question: Where do I pick up my laptop on my first day?
items.referenceAnswer: At the IT Service Point in room B2.17 (Building B, second floor), open Monday to Friday 08:00–16:30; laptop pickup is scheduled for 11:00 on your first day.

items.question: As a new employee, how long do I have to finish the mandatory security awareness course?
items.referenceAnswer: The SEC-100 security awareness training must be completed in Orbitwell Academy within 10 working days of your start date; until then your Orbitwell ID only gives access to email and Orbitwell Academy.

items.question: Which HTTP header carries the signature on Orbitwell Fleet webhooks, and how is the signature computed?
items.referenceAnswer: Webhook deliveries carry the X-Orbitwell-Signature header (t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>), where v1 is the hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of '{t}.{raw request body}' keyed with the webhook signing secret; deliveries older than 300 seconds should be rejected.

items.question: How do I page through long lists in the Fleet API, and how many items can one page hold at most?
items.referenceAnswer: List endpoints use cursor pagination: pass the next_cursor value from each response as the cursor parameter until next_cursor is null. The limit parameter defaults to 50 and allows at most 200 items per page.

items.question: If the fire alarm goes off while I'm in the robotics lab, where should I gather outside?
items.referenceAnswer: Leave by the nearest marked exit without using the lift and go to Assembly Point 3 in the north car park, next to the bicycle shelter, where lab wardens take a roll call.

items.question: How much revenue did Orbitwell make in Q2 2026, and how does that compare with a year earlier?
items.referenceAnswer: Q2 2026 revenue was €48.6 million, up 21% year over year from €40.2 million in Q2 2025.

items.question: Our OW-X7 keeps raising E-214 on Monday mornings in an unheated hall. What does the error mean, and which firmware version stops these false alarms?
items.referenceAnswer: E-214 means an encoder mismatch on joint 2 (motor-side and output-side readings differ by more than 0.5°). Spurious E-214 errors after cold starts below 8 °C were fixed in firmware 3.3.1 (7 April 2026); on 3.3.0 the workaround is to leave the robot idle for 10 minutes before production.

items.question: I'm a new hire who will work in the robot cells. What training must I complete before I'm allowed into the lab, and what protective gear do I need in the robot cell zone?
items.referenceAnswer: You must pass the Lab Safety Induction LS-101 (a four-hour session every Thursday 08:30–12:30 in Safety Training Room C1.05) before lab access is granted. In Zone R, the robot cells, you must wear S3 safety shoes and safety glasses at all times.

items.question: A Premier customer phones support saying their Fleet API credentials have leaked. How quickly must we respond, and how fast and where does the support engineer have to report it internally?
items.referenceAnswer: Suspected security incidents are always P1, so the Premier response target is 15 minutes. The engineer must also report it internally within 60 minutes of discovery to security@orbitwell.example or the 24/7 Security hotline on extension 7110.

items.question: I joined Orbitwell recently. When will I be eligible for a corporate card, and what monthly spending limit will it have?
items.referenceAnswer: The corporate card is issued to employees who travel regularly once they have successfully completed probation, which lasts 4 months (8 months for managerial positions); the standard monthly limit is €3,500.

items.question: Did the Orbitwell Fleet platform meet its uptime commitment in Q2 2026?
items.referenceAnswer: Yes. Fleet availability in Q2 2026 was 99.98%, above the 99.9% monthly uptime commitment in the support SLA.

items.question: I'm pregnant. How long can I stay home with my newborn without losing any income?
items.referenceAnswer: As the birth parent you get 20 weeks of leave at 100% of salary (Orbitwell tops up the statutory maternity benefit), and you can work 80% of your hours on full pay during your first month back.

items.question: How many people can stand inside the robot enclosure while a colleague is moving the arm step by step to record positions?
items.referenceAnswer: In teach mode at most two people may be inside the robot cell: the operator holding the enabling device and one observer who stays outside the arm's reach. Robot speed is limited to 250 mm/s.

items.question: When I'm working in Zurich for a few days, how much can I claim each day for food?
items.referenceAnswer: Zurich is a Tier 1 city, so the per diem is €76 per day; it covers meals, local public transport and tips, and is reduced when meals are provided.

items.question: Our backend signs in to the robot cloud with a machine login. How long does each login stay good before we have to sign in again?
items.referenceAnswer: Access tokens issued by the Fleet token endpoint (OAuth 2.0 client credentials) are valid for 45 minutes (expires_in 2700). There are no refresh tokens, so request a new token shortly before the current one expires.

items.question: Who is the CEO of Orbitwell Robotics?
items.referenceAnswer: The knowledge base does not contain this information. No document names a CEO or any other executive; the Q2 2026 update is signed only by the leadership team.

items.question: What is Orbitwell's stock ticker symbol?
items.referenceAnswer: The knowledge base does not contain this information. No document mentions a stock exchange listing or a ticker symbol.

items.question: What is the salary band for a senior robotics engineer at Orbitwell?
items.referenceAnswer: The knowledge base does not contain this information. The Employee Handbook covers working hours, leave and remote work, but no document lists salary bands.

items.question: What is the maximum payload of the OW-X9 robot arm?
items.referenceAnswer: The knowledge base does not contain this information. No OW-X9 model is documented; the corpus only describes the OW-X7.
